content.value_statement: PRD work often becomes vague, unconfirmed, or hard to hand off. This skill guides structured discovery, story confirmation, diagrams, and final PRD generation.
actual_capabilities: Builds a confirmed user journey map before drafting the full PRD.
Guides each user story through focused questions and single-point confirmation.
Requires ASCII wireframes for stories that include user interface decisions.
Adds Mermaid flow, state, or sequence diagrams for product behavior alignment.
Generates a final PRD using the included structured template.
Can prepare a PRD registry row for project documentation tracking.
limitations: It depends on user-provided product facts and should not invent missing requirements.
It does not replace stakeholder approval, legal review, or engineering estimation.
The diagrams are text drafts and may need design or architecture refinement.
Registry updates need confirmed version IDs and repository paths from the user.

use_cases.title: Define a New Product Feature
use_cases.description: Turn an early feature idea into a staged PRD with stories, rules, edge cases, and acceptance criteria.

use_cases.title: Clarify UI Requirements
use_cases.description: Align a team on page structure and user-visible behavior through ASCII wireframes and Mermaid diagrams.

use_cases.title: Prepare Development Handoff
use_cases.description: Convert confirmed requirements into a developer-ready document with clear scope, non-goals, and testable outcomes.

prompt_templates.title: Start a PRD
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a rough feature idea.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a PRD for [feature]. Start by asking questions, then build a journey map before drafting anything.

prompt_templates.title: Detail User Stories
prompt_templates.scenario: Expand an agreed journey map into stories.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this journey map: [paste map]. Walk through each stage and help me define user stories, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Add Visual Alignment
prompt_templates.scenario: Clarify UI and behavior for a product flow.
prompt_templates.prompt: For this UI story, create an ASCII wireframe and a Mermaid flow diagram. Ask for confirmation before moving to acceptance criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Finalize and Register
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a finished PRD and registry entry.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review our confirmed stories, surface missing decisions, then generate the final PRD. Also prepare a PRD registry row for version [version].

output_examples.input: A product manager needs a PRD for a bulk task creation page.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a confirmed journey map, story cards, edge cases, acceptance criteria, and a final PRD outline.

output_examples.input: A team cannot agree on how a checkout error flow should behave.
output_examples.output: The skill creates a user-visible flow diagram, confirms each branch, and records recovery behavior in the PRD.

output_examples.input: A founder has notes for an MVP but no handoff document.
output_examples.output: The skill turns the notes into a structured PRD with scope, non-goals, user stories, and a registry summary.

best_practices: Provide real user roles, goals, business rules, and known constraints before final generation.
Confirm each journey stage and user story before asking for the complete PRD.
Use diagrams for flows with branches, states, timing, or user-visible failure handling.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a final PRD before the journey map and stories are confirmed.
Do not use it to invent product decisions that stakeholders have not approved.
Do not treat ASCII wireframes as final visual design specifications.

faq.question: What kind of PRD does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates story-driven PRDs with journey maps, user stories, business rules, edge cases, acceptance criteria, and optional registry rows.

faq.question: Does it support Chinese PRD workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. The source instructions are bilingual and include Chinese terms for PRD writing, user stories, and confirmation steps.

faq.question: Can it draw interface layouts?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses ASCII wireframes for UI stories to align layout before acceptance criteria are finalized.

faq.question: When should Mermaid diagrams be used?
faq.answer: Use Mermaid diagrams for flows, states, sequences, branches, timing, retries, and user-visible failure paths.

faq.question: Will it update my repository files automatically?
faq.answer: No. It prepares PRD text and registry rows. File updates require a separate user request in a capable tool.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
